sql: SELECT d.company_name, count(*) AS listings FROM fct_posting f JOIN dim_company d USING (company_key) WHERE d.platform = 'ashby' AND f.is_open AND f.remote_us AND f.is_canonical_listing GROUP BY d.company_name HAVING count(*) > 5 ORDER BY listings DESC
